 Scimitars are a type of one-handed martial melee weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most scimitars, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Scimitar. Further down below, you can find a list of all scimitars in the game.

Properties

Damage
1d6 (1~6) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠Slashing
Details
 One-Handed
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Finesse
 Light
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Lacerate ()
Slash at your target's vital points to make it  Bleed. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Flourish ()
Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent  Off Balance. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
